```{python}
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)

HIDE = ["lematy", "cls", "n_mat_kontrast", "n_klas_cel", "rozproszenie", "termopl_ok", "kategoria_final", "model_sedzia",
        "udzial_nazw_wlasnych", "ll_vs_kwjp", "log_ratio_kwjp", "freq_kwjp", "zipf_wordfreq", "duplikat_formy", "typ_szumu",
        "pelny_termin", "warstwa", "kand_przedmiotowy", "kand_ogolny", "etykieta_regulowa", "forma_kandydata", "warianty",
        "freq_kontrast_laczna", "srebrny_pojecie_ref"]
pp, po, poj = L.csv("pula_przedmiotowa.csv"), L.csv("pula_ogolna.csv"), L.csv("pojecia.csv")
m6 = L.metrics("pule_6")
dp = m6.get("dopasowanie", {})
hide = lambda df: [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith("rank_") or c.endswith(("_pewnosc", "_uzasadnienie", "_kategoria")) or c in HIDE]
n = lambda v: L.fmt(int(v))
by_freq = lambda df: [[list(df.columns).index("freq_cel"), "desc"]]
extra_path = L.OUT / "terminy_llm_spoza_kandydatow.csv"
```

The pools are built from the final labels of step 5 only: **T3** (biology terms) form the subject pool, **T1** and
**T2** (everyday and school vocabulary) the general pool. Terms of other subjects (`T3_INNY`) and noise (`SZUM`)
are in neither. Nothing here has been checked by a human; rows with `do_przegladu` = `True` are the ones the models
could not settle.

Each subject term is paired with at most one general-pool item of the same part of speech and number of words, as
close as possible in general frequency (Zipf scale) and length in letters. The assignment is optimal over the whole
pool (Hungarian algorithm, no item used twice) and a pair is formed only within
`{python} L.fmt(dp.get("progi", {}).get("max_roznica_zipf"))` Zipf units and
`{python} L.fmt(dp.get("progi", {}).get("max_roznica_liter"))` letters
(`{python} L.fmt(dp.get("progi", {}).get("max_roznica_liter_frazy"))` for phrases). Single words are matched on their
KWJP100 frequency; phrases, for which no general-Polish frequency exists, on their frequency in the ZPE stage corpus.
`{python} n(dp.get("n_dopasowanych", 0))` of `{python} n(dp.get("n_terminow", 0))` terms have a match; balance before
and after matching is on the [Results](results.qmd#pools) page.

Filter with the boxes under the table, sort by clicking a header, and use **Columns** to show the hidden columns.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Subject pool (T3)

`{python} n(len(pp))` terms, `{python} n((pp["dlugosc"] > 1).sum())` of them multiword;
`{python} n(pp["dopasowanie_ogolne"].notna().sum())` matched to a general-pool item.

```{python}
L.source("pula_przedmiotowa.csv")
L.glossary(pp.columns)
L.dt(pp, order=by_freq(pp), hide=hide(pp), wrap=["pojecie"])
```

## General pool (T1/T2)

`{python} n(len(po))` items: `{python} n((po["kategoria"] == "T1").sum())` T1 and
`{python} n((po["kategoria"] == "T2").sum())` T2. `{python} n(po["dopasowanie_przedmiotowe"].notna().sum())` of them
are matched to a subject term.

```{python}
L.source("pula_ogolna.csv")
L.glossary(po.columns)
L.dt(po, order=by_freq(po), hide=hide(po))
```

## Concepts

`{python} n(len(poj))` concepts; `{python} n((poj["n_terminow"] > 1).sum())` of them group more than one term
(spelling variants, synonyms, a noun and its adjective). The grouping is one request to the language model over the
whole list of subject terms; a term the model left alone is its own concept.

```{python}
L.source("pojecia.csv")
L.glossary(poj.columns)
L.dt(poj, order=[[list(poj.columns).index("n_terminow"), "desc"]], wrap=["terminy", "pojecie", "dopasowanie_ogolne"])
```

## Terms the extraction missed

```{python}
if extra_path.exists():
    ex = L.csv("terminy_llm_spoza_kandydatow.csv")
    L.md(f"As a check on step 4, a language model listed terms directly from a sample of materials. These "
         f"{n(len(ex))} terms are **not** among the candidates: they occurred too rarely in the sample, or their form "
         "does not fit the syntactic patterns used for multiword candidates. They are not in the pools.")
    L.source("terminy_llm_spoza_kandydatow.csv")
    L.glossary(ex.columns)
    L.dt(ex, order=[[list(ex.columns).index("n_materialow"), "desc"]])
else:
    L.md("Direct extraction by a language model was not run.")
```
